slowest_experiments.title: Pre-gate block: Exp 931 Combined Math+Estimation Pipeline
slowest_experiments.why_long: Pre-gate/self-heal handling consumed wall time before useful experiment work could start; gate failures should fail fast with actionable artifacts.

bottlenecks_identified: The top five slowest tasks consumed 88 of 130 minutes, or 67.7% of the milestone wall time, so latency was concentrated in a small number of operational lanes.
Inline documentation reconciliation was the largest avoidable class: exp950_docs and exp946_docs consumed 39 minutes, 30.0% of the full milestone wall time.
GPU utilization was inefficient. The close report showed both RTX 3090s at 4/24576MB, 0% utilization, with gpu_monitor.py recommending DualGPURunner parallel execution.
No formal GPU zombie process was visible in the supplied monitor report. The 4MB allocations look like idle driver/context residue, not resource-wasting model processes.
GPU-eligible and independent work was effectively serialized or blocked before execution. Qwen/Gemma inference should have occupied separate GPUs when gates allowed it.
Pre-flight and pre-gate checks were a bottleneck. The slowest five include a 10-minute pre-gate block, and .93 artifacts show repeated pre-test/self-heal skips for exp1192, exp1193, and exp1197.

Failure-ledger prior_failures handling created false pre-gate blocks for build-on-prior work. Existing .93 blocked artifacts show missing prior_failures stopped exp1196, exp1198, exp1200, and exp1201 before useful work.
Full-corpus exploratory sweeps were too expensive for the feedback loop. exp948 should default to sampled fast-eval unless the task is explicitly a certification run.
Memory and repair-style benchmarks remained serial. exp935-style state construction and evaluation should reuse cached corpus features and recompute only changed logic.
Doc reconciliation passes were not efficient: two separate in-process doc jobs landed in the slowest five instead of one async milestone-close reconciliation job.
improvements_suggested: Move ops/changelog/roadmap/spec documentation reconciliation out of the main experiment lane and run it as one async milestone-close batch.
Make DualGPURunner the default for GPU-eligible tasks: reserve GPU 0 for Qwen-class work and GPU 1 for Gemma-class work unless a task explicitly opts out.
Add a stale-context cleanup mode to scripts/gpu_monitor.py for idle allocations below the formal zombie threshold, while keeping the existing >1GB zombie rule for kills.
Auto-populate prior_failures from the failure ledger at plan or activation time, then require the planner to classify true failures versus successful upstream dependencies.
Implement CARNOT_FAST_EVAL=1 for FoVer/Symbolic-KAN exploratory runs, using stratified samples by default and full-corpus sweeps only for certification artifacts.
Cache stable benchmark outputs for CaseMemory, repair, and verifier fixtures so repeat experiments perform delta evaluation instead of replaying unchanged baselines.
Fail pre-gate checks faster by writing a structured blocked artifact on the first deterministic gate miss, then stop retrying until the missing prior or upstream field changes.
Split conductor execution into CPU-doc, CPU-eval, GPU-model, and gated-publication lanes so independent work does not serialize behind docs or gate repair.
Batch model inference at 8-16 questions per forward pass where memory allows; gpu_monitor.py already identifies single-process inference as a throughput smell.
Increase retro task budgets and require skeleton-first artifact writes so operational retros do not fail with artifact_not_updated_past_bootstrap after analysis has already started.
